sources.title: Afghanistan: travel and security advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Federal Foreign Office page directly addresses German nationals and was current on 24 August 2026. It is used only to document the warning and unresolved audit because it says entry rules are based on information known through August 2021 and may change without notice.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Deutsche Staatsangehörige benötigen für die Einreise nach Afghanistan ein Visum

unresolved.reason: Germany's current Foreign Office page says Germans need a visa and should apply before entry at an Afghan foreign representation, but it expressly bases entry information on rules known through August 2021 and warns they may change. Germany's Kabul Embassy is closed; the linked Afghan-mission address no longer resolves to an authenticated current visa-issuing authority. No current primary Afghan or German source proves a usable ordinary German-passport short-visitor issuance channel, so the advance-visa fallback is not normalized.
